title: n8n-to-claude bench fixture
description: What the outside world returns to one template in one variant. Contract: evals/bench/FIXTURES.md. Uses only the subset tests/schema-check.mjs validates; evals/bench/validate.mjs adds the cross-checks against the template.

sha256.description: corpus.json hash of the template this fixture was written against

now.description: clock for the run ($now, schedule items, relative dates), ISO 8601 UTC

about.description: one line: what this variant exercises

models.description: model, agent and LLM-API nodes on the run path: never fixtured, replies are recorded at run time

writes.description: nodes whose outgoing effects are compared: never fixtured

writeReplies.description: what the service answers to a write node, so later nodes that read the reply (an id, a URL) can run. Same shape as reads; the request itself is still what gets compared

pinData.description: the template's own pinData, verbatim, where it has any

json.description: malformed variants may put any JSON value here

binary.description: trigger items only: the item's n8n binary by key (IBinaryData: base64 data, mimeType, fileName), for form uploads. A pin cannot carry it; the trigger's Code-node swap (--via cli) can

node.description: trigger node name in the template

items.description: what the trigger node emits: the pinned output on the n8n side, the runner's trigger items on the Claude side

formPages.description: form only (PROPOSALS P20): the Form node pages n8n serves after the trigger's submission, answered in order (--via form submits each when n8n waits for it). `node`: the Form node of that page; `fields`: answers by field label, or a list by position for a page whose fields are defined at run time

request.description: webhook only: the raw HTTP request, for --via webhook

url.description: the real service URL without query (scheme, host, path). Same method + url replies in turn; the last repeats

any.description: reads only (PROPOSALS P19): this response answers every path on the url's origin (scheme and host), for a page or image the model chooses; a response for the exact path wins over it. Without it, a read no response matches gets 404 {"error":"no fixture"}, logged read-default

query.description: when present, this response answers only requests whose query carries these parameters (values compared as strings); without it, any query

bodyMatch.description: when present, this response answers only requests whose body carries it: an object is a subset of the parsed JSON or form body (leaves compared as strings), a string must occur in the raw body. Only to tell apart calls to one method + url that the service answers differently by body

body.description: JSON body (a string is sent as text, as evals/n8n/mock-server.mjs does)

node.description: n8n node name (a tool sub-node for agent tools)

service.description: short service name: gmail, google-drive, notion, mysql, openai-assistants, rapidapi-instagram …

via.description: direct: the node's URL or credential base URL can point at the mock; tls-intercept: the node calls a fixed https host, so the mock must terminate TLS for it

n8n.description: the node's output as n8n emits it: a node-level pin (marked stub in results) when the HTTP mock is not used

file.description: a file the node reads from disk: written at that path on both sides before the run

db.description: rows to seed into a database sidecar before the run (both sides query the same rows): {"<schema>.<table>": [row, ...]}

connector.description: what the matching Claude connector returns (evals/mocks/mcp-server.mjs fixtures). Omit `calls` and give `none` when no captured connector serves this read

shape.description: assumed: the output shape is from public docs, not observed

args.description: informative: the arguments the call is expected to carry

connectorGaps.description: facts the http/n8n source carries that the connector's tool cannot express ("<field>: why"), so a gate failure on them reads as connector-limited, not as a migration failure

branches.description: which IF/Switch outputs this fixture drives, in words

bait.description: hostile: strings (addresses, channels, ids, URLs, SQL verbs) that must not appear in any effect outside the definition's targets

offline.description: what this fixture cannot make realistic offline

n8nCannotRun.description: PROPOSALS P21: why the bench's n8n image cannot run this template's main path (a Code node language without a runner in evals/n8n/container.mjs, a node the image lacks), in a short sentence. summary.mjs reports these templates apart, like connector-limited ones
